```plato
    // Every masked edge split at once. Old vertices keep their numbers and the
    // midpoints follow them in edge order.
    SplitEdges(self: TriangleMesh3D, topology: TriangleMeshTopology, splitMask: Array<Boolean>): TriangleMesh3D
    {
        var midpointOf = SplitVertexNumbers(splitMask, self.Positions.Count);
        return (self.Positions.Concatenate(self.SplitMidpoints(topology, splitMask)),
                self.Faces.Count.MapRange(f => f).FlatMap(f =>
                    SplitFaceTriangles(
                        self.Faces[f].A, self.Faces[f].B, self.Faces[f].C,
                        midpointOf[topology.CornerEdges[f * 3].Value],
                        midpointOf[topology.CornerEdges[f * 3 + 1].Value],
                        midpointOf[topology.CornerEdges[f * 3 + 2].Value])));
    }
```
